P. T. Barnum, The Art of Money Getting.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/p-t-barnum/the-art-of-money-getting

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- P. T. Barnum, the author, died 1891 (Wikidata Q223766; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/P._T._Barnum).

First publication of the text used: 1880 (SE colophon: 'The Art of Money Getting was published in 1880 by P. T. Barnum.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1880, before 1931. Works published before 1931 are in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: not needed. Every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

- P. T. Barnum: death year 1891 from the gathered facts (Wikidata Q223766; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/P._T._Barnum).
